comment: JAM message catalogue of the Overwatch 0.8 beta client (build 24919). Source of server/inst/jam (go generate).

Layouts: the client's own field tables (Prometheus jam_protocol_dump -> game/owbetaclient/Prometheus/jam_protocols.json), reseeded with `go run ./jamgen seed`; curated fields (names, notes, handlers, tags) are kept.

Types: bool (bit-packed), char, u8, i8, u16, i16, u32, i32, u64, i64, f32, f64, str (NUL-terminated), blob (fixed size), bytes (u32 length + bytes), tid (tagged ID), struct, or a named type below. array: [] = u32 count + elements, N = fixed.
RVAs are relative to the image base (Ghidra 0x7ff64ffe0000). Tags: G Ghidra, L live capture, K early notes (docs/early-notes, docs/JAM.md §12.5), H confirmed in game.

types.name: JamID
types.notes: JAM's 128-bit address {seq, src}; used for players, parties, games, channels (every 16-byte ID in the lobby).

types.name: EntityID
types.notes: A client entity ID (0x40000000 | n for server entities).

types.name: ChatUser
types.notes: A chat participant {BattleTag, account ID}.

types.name: ChatChannelState
types.notes: A joined channel: the channel's disabled bits 0-1 (set by 20404), bit 2 (20405), the channel.

types.name: Unlock
types.notes: An owned unlock {bool, i32 level, u64 asset GUID 0x025..., u64}; every unlock list loads its assets into profile +0x188.

types.name: HeroRecord
types.notes: A hero progression record (0x98 bytes, copied field for field by FUN_7ff650f9b9e0): level, hero GUID 0x02E..., xp (+0x10, VM 0x4ACDC2D3), xp to next (+0x18) [?], equipped skin +0x20, equipped unlocks +0x28..+0x60 (SkinTheme, HeroMod 0-2, POTG intro, spray, class 0x5F38A9D5, trophy), per-skin themes {ctx = skin, theme}, owned hero unlocks. docs/TitleScreen.md §5.

types.name: PartyMember
types.notes: A party member (0x50 bytes): BattleTag (shown without #1234); leader with status 5-7; status 1-4 = class 1, 5-7 = class 2/3; icon = player icon unlock 0x025...; player ID = the member key (the client finds itself by its 20500 ID). server/internal/lobbylogic/party.go.

types.name: GameID
types.notes: A custom game ID (u64[2]); 23304 carries the game the client sends back on Start.

types.name: GameInfo
types.notes: A custom game header (23301, 23303, 23312); kind = 24001 type (1 custom, 2 dev, 3 practice vs AI, 4 tutorial).

types.name: MatchmakingTicket
types.notes: A matchmaking ticket (25600).

types.name: QueueStats
types.notes: Matchmaking panel numbers: good 1 = "FINDING A GOOD MATCH"; "<found> OF <needed> PLAYERS FOUND"; fill/4 picks the hexagon image (docs/LobbyServer.md).

types.name: QueueEntry
types.notes: A matchmaking queue entry (25600 last list) [?].

types.name: QueueStatus
types.notes: The matchmaking state (25600, also in Relationship records): status + queue stats + tickets; 0->1 tickets = searching, 1->0 = stopped (docs/LobbyServer.md "Matchmaking").

types.name: CustomGameSettings
types.notes: Custom game settings (0xC8 bytes; 23303, 23305, 24008): start flag (FUN_7ff650beebf0), bot count (FUN_7ff650beeb40), bots {difficulty, hero} (FUN_7ff650beed50), map mode + maps (FUN_7ff650bedf90). server/internal/lobbylogic/customgame.go.

types.name: StatList
types.notes: A stat list keyed by hero/map GUID.

types.name: FriendEntry
types.notes: A friends-list entry (27100 list 1, 27101, 27105): flags 1 = favourite.

types.name: FriendRequest
types.notes: An incoming friend request (27100 list 2, 27103).

types.name: PresenceRecord
types.notes: A Battle.net presence record: attrs = serialized bgs FieldKey + Variant; the game-account record's parent is the account.

types.name: Currency
types.notes: A currency balance.

protocols.name: Negotiation
protocols.notes: Channel 0 on every lobby link. Registered by FUN_7ff650f0b3e0 (not in the dump: layouts from the .data tables). The client (link flag +0x82 = 0) sends 1, waits for 3, then sends 4 every 10 s.

messages.name: NegotiateProtocols
messages.notes: The CRCs of the protocols registered for the peer's server type, sorted; channels 1..n are created in this order. Don't echo it (the client's handler requires state 2).

messages.name: NegotiateDescriptors
messages.notes: The other link mode's descriptor list (flag +0x82 != 0; JSON fallback on CRC mismatch). Not used by the game client.

messages.name: NegotiateAccept
messages.notes: Accepts the client's list: link state 3 -> 5 (up).

messages.name: NegotiateKeepalive
messages.notes: Sent by the client every 10 s once the link is up; no reply.

protocols.name: ClientInInstance
protocols.notes: Instance stream channel 0. Unknown IDs close the link.

messages.name: InstanceSetMap
messages.label: Set the wanted map
messages.notes: Like 20600's map: the WorldEngineSystem reloads to it.

messages.name: LocalEntity
messages.label: The local (controller) entity
messages.notes: Stores the entity at entityAdmin+0x220 (msg +0x80), the local entity system 8 waits for; clears +0xda.

messages.name: Instance20302
messages.notes: Calls vfunc +0x10 of the object at +0x20 with the byte.

messages.name: Instance20303
messages.notes: No handler logic.

messages.name: TimeSyncPong
messages.label: Time-sync pong
messages.notes: Answers 21608: the client's times plus ours.

messages.name: Instance20305
messages.notes: Global DAT_7ff651797fe4 = the float.

messages.name: InstanceTextPopup
messages.label: Popup with text
messages.notes: Formats string 0x0DE...112B (flag set) or ...112C with the text.

protocols.name: ClientInLobbyChallenge
protocols.notes: All three messages are accepted and ignored.

messages.name: ChatMessage
messages.label: A chat line
messages.notes: Shown unless the sender ID equals self; a zero ID shows as a system message; registers the sender name.

messages.name: ChatChannelsJoined
messages.label: Joined channels
messages.notes: Joins each channel (flags must be 0); TAB cycles through them.

messages.name: ChatIDList
messages.label: Adds IDs to the chat ID list +0x128
messages.notes: Probably a mute/ignore list [?].

protocols.name: ClientInLobbyConnect
protocols.notes: Lobby connect replies (receiver FUN_7ff650c47aa0 returns early if msg +0x48 != 0).

messages.name: ConnectAccepted
messages.label: Connect accepted
messages.notes: Stores the player ID at profile +0x60/+0x68 (= "self" for chat/party) and the string at +0x70 (social header, own chat lines), sets flag 0x10000, flushes pending items.

messages.name: ConnectReady
messages.label: Leaves "Authenticating"
messages.notes: Profile +0x23c = 1; auto-presses Play if DAT_7ff651811dd7 is set.

messages.name: LobbyDisconnect
messages.label: Lobby disconnect response
messages.notes: Sets the lobby status slot to 1 or 5. Do not send.

messages.name: TactKeys
messages.label: TACT key delivery
messages.notes: Key names + 16 bytes per key into the keyring, then loads package 0x06E...079 on the lobby load group. Sent empty (Prometheus injects the keys).

messages.name: ExtraPackages
messages.label: Extra data packages
messages.notes: Four GUID lists fed to the data-pack loader in the order 3, 1, 2, 4 [?].

messages.name: ConnectNop
messages.notes: No handler logic.

messages.name: CustomGameMaps
messages.label: Map picker options
messages.notes: Custom and practice MAP picker map lists (+0x40, +0x58).

messages.name: CustomGameJoined
messages.label: You're in this game
messages.notes: gameinfo -> +0x70, settings -> +0xb8 and +0x210.

messages.name: CustomGameLobby
messages.label: Lobby state (slots)
messages.notes: game = the ID Start (24013) sends back; slots: kind 1 = human in a team column, team 0/1 (2 = spectator), bot != 0 = AI.

messages.name: HeroProgression
messages.label: Hero progression
messages.notes: levelCap -> profile +0xF0; records replace +0xF8; rewards (hero -> next rewards) replace +0x120.

messages.name: HeroSkin
messages.label: Equip skin
messages.notes: Record +0x20 = skin; {hero, 0} removes the title hero, {hero, skin} builds it again.

messages.name: HeroEquip
messages.label: Equip unlock
messages.notes: By unlock class (SkinTheme ctx = skin, HeroMod, POTG, spray, trophy, 0x5F38A9D5; AvatarPortrait -> profile +0x150). No-op unless the unlock is loaded.

messages.name: InstanceConnect
messages.label: Game found: connect to the instance server
messages.notes: Sets the wanted map (STUMapHeader.m_map; loading screen, then hero select) and connects the UDP instance transport to host:port with connID and the 20-byte HMAC key; stores the instance ID at lobby +0x228/+0x230.

messages.name: InstancePopup
messages.label: Popup with a string ID
messages.notes: Same popup as ClientInInstance 20307.

messages.name: InstanceInfo
messages.label: Print only: map / instance type / players

messages.name: QueueUpdate
messages.label: Queue ticket update
messages.notes: The server drives the panel by re-sending it.

messages.name: Matchmaking25604
messages.notes: [FUN_7ff650c28dc0()]+0x18 = value [?].

messages.name: Matchmaking25605
messages.notes: Global DAT_7ff651813dfc = value [?].

messages.name: PartyState
messages.label: Full party state
messages.notes: Enables Play/Custom/Practice/Tutorial on the title screen; the title name and portrait come from the local member.

messages.name: Party20706
messages.notes: Ignored.

messages.name: Party20707
messages.notes: Ignored.

messages.name: PlayerSettings
messages.label: Saved player settings
messages.notes: f32 @0x68 -> settings +0x6dc (probably sensitivity [?]); the list = key bindings through the 0x82-entry action table DAT_7ff6517061e0; bytes @0x76-0x79 -> profile +0x238..+0x23b.

messages.name: PlayerNotice
messages.label: Popup: indexed notice
messages.notes: String DAT_7ff6515a3fb0[index].

messages.name: PlayTime
messages.label: CAIS play-time tracker
messages.notes: Profile +0x18/+0x20/+0x28; the 3 h / 5 h popups are client-side.

messages.name: PlayerProfile
messages.label: Reply to a pending profile request ("inspect player" [?])

messages.name: PlayerProgression
messages.label: Player progression
messages.notes: account.tutorialDone -> profile +0x148 (0 = "PLAY THE TUTORIAL?" every time), icon -> +0x150 (equipped player icon), owned -> +0x158; b.unlocks -> +0x170.

protocols.name: ClientInLobbyStore
protocols.notes: Balances at profile +0xd8, owned products at +0x90.

messages.name: StoreOwned
messages.label: Owned products + balances
messages.notes: Every hero owned: the hero page opens details instead of the Unlock sheet.

messages.name: PlayerTransform
messages.label: Sent during the map load
messages.notes: Meaning of the values unclear [?].

messages.name: MapLoaded
messages.label: Map loaded
messages.notes: Sent by the map world "finished" callback FUN_7ff650c9fc20: the join / world setup trigger.

messages.name: HeroLockIn
messages.label: Hero select confirm (lock in)
messages.notes: UXSendHeroSelection behaviour 1 (after 21605 {0, 1, 1}).

messages.name: HeroSelect
messages.label: Hero click (preview)
messages.notes: UXSendHeroSelection behaviour 0 = preview {hero, bool, 0}, 2 = {hero, bool, 1}, 1 = confirm {0, 1, 1}.

messages.name: TimeSyncPing
messages.label: Time-sync ping
messages.notes: Answered with 20304.

messages.name: ChatListMembers
messages.label: /list
messages.notes: Answered with 20401.

messages.name: LobbyConnect
messages.label: Connect request
messages.notes: First message after the link is up; answered with 20500, 20501, 20503 (+ progression, party, social). client.version = "Overwatch/0.8.0.0 Beta/24919"; sessionKey 64 bytes (probably the Battle.net session key [?]); platform "Win", locale "enUS"; gameAccount = the game-account EntityId.

messages.name: LeaveGame
messages.label: Leave game
messages.notes: "Leave Game" in a match (server: release the game connection).

messages.name: CustomGameCreate
messages.label: Create a custom game / practice / tutorial
messages.notes: kind 1 custom, 2 dev custom, 3 practice vs AI, 4 tutorial; strings empty.

messages.name: CustomGameStart
messages.label: Start
messages.notes: u0 = 1, game = the 23304 game ID.

messages.name: FriendAddRequest
messages.label: Add friend
messages.notes: kind 1 BattleTag, 2 e-mail.

messages.name: FriendRequestAnswer
messages.label: Answer a friend request
messages.notes: action 0 = accept.

messages.name: FriendSetFlags
messages.label: Friend flags (favourite)
messages.notes: Answered with 27105.
